children: The USDA says that total hog and pig inventories through Sept. 1 totaled 74.3 million head, a 1.5 percentage-point reduction from the same time last year. It's a bigger decrease than expected by most analysts, who were largely anticipating a decrease of less than one point. Hogs kept for breeding and hogs marketed also fell from the same time last year, with 5.88 million head kept for breeding, a one point decrease. Hogs marketed totaled 68.43 million head, which is 1.6 points down from the same time last year. Most-active lean hog futures settled down 1% to 69.65 cents a pound. Live cattle futures finish down 0.6% to $2.2105 a pound. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
